probes.proposition: After a local writer is killed at the append boundary, a fresh Core reader in the isolated scratch filesystem replays the same delivery_started attempt identity and native ledger digest.
blind_spots: Power loss, disk/controller failure and production mount or storage health
Other crash windows, the whole ledger, or continuous fsync and OwnerLock guarantees
Workflow delivery and original business acceptance

probes.proposition: A fresh isolated child executes on the declared Node release and actually loads the three pinned ledger, engine and Router store entry sources with the expected exports.
blind_spots: Transitive dependency behavior, installed production version, deployment and continuous process liveness

probes.proposition: At observation time the isolated loopback channel returns the persisted Core Router receipt for the original request identity.
blind_spots: The production Router uses an in-process dependency and follows a separate runtime path
The successful query establishes receipt readback and leaves the business effect undecided
Nonresponse or an unrecognized response does not establish Router state
